description: Use this when the user asks what mailing a card to an imported list costs or when it will arrive. Returns the price per card (First-Class postage included), the total for the ready recipients, the send date and the expected arrival window. For a card preview with the price, first create or edit it with design_card, then pass that exact design_id here. This shows the current saved front and back above the quote. design_id is required: use null only when the user requested a price-only quote without a design. Never claim a preview is shown when preview_included is false. If the cards must arrive by a date, pass arrive_by; the result gives the latest safe send date and whether that date can be met. Does not create an order or charge anything.

arrive_by.description: Date the cards should arrive by, YYYY-MM-DD.

design_id.description: Required preview choice. Use the exact design_id returned by design_card for a preview with price. Use null only for a price-only request without a design. Do not omit.

send_date.description: Date to print and mail, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the latest safe date for arrive_by, otherwise the earliest business day (today if it is one).
